ValidationRule.description: A total spans many lines, so pointing it at one of them is always wrong. Same for a Rounding row - a whole-table adjustment, not derived from one line. Discount is excluded here; a discount is normally tied to the one line it discounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Group Header") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Subtotal") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Section Total") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Grand Total") || ISPICKVAL(Row_Type__c, "Rounding"), NOT(ISBLANK(Quote_Line__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Aggregate rows and Rounding adjustments must not reference a Source Quote Line.
